# Batch History

Message counts per dataflow by status for a time window.

2 operation(s). Base URL `https://vannbros-qa.burqio.site`; `{version}` in a path is `1`. Calls need `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (see ../SKILL.md). **Read-only for QA:** only GETs, and not the GETs SKILL.md lists as side-effecting.

## Operations

| Method | Path | operationId |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/v{version}/BatchHistory/countByDataflow`](#op-batchhistory-getcountbydataflow) | BatchHistory_GetCountByDataflow |
| POST | [`/api/v{version}/BatchHistory/send-summary`](#op-batchhistory-sendsummary) | BatchHistory_SendSummary |

<a id="op-batchhistory-getcountbydataflow"></a>
### GET `/api/v{version}/BatchHistory/countByDataflow`

operationId `BatchHistory_GetCountByDataflow` · Retrieves message counts per dataflow, broken down by status, for a time window

| Param | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `FromDate` | query | string (date-time) |  | Start of the window (UTC). Defaults to 24 hours before ToDate. |
| `ToDate` | query | string (date-time) |  | End of the window (UTC). Defaults to now. |
| `IncludeHidden` | query | boolean |  | non-nullable (omitted → server default, e.g. 0/false); Include dataflows that have been hidden from the listings. |
| `IsChildIncluded` | query | boolean |  | non-nullable (omitted → server default, e.g. 0/false); Include child messages. Defaults to false so the totals match the per-dataflow Batch History tab, which also counts parent messages only. |
| `version` | path | string | yes |  |

Request body: _none_

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [ResultOfListOfGetDataPacketsCountByDataflowResponse](#schema-resultoflistofgetdatapacketscountbydataflowresponse) | Counts retrieved successfully |
| `400` | [ResultOfListOfGetDataPacketsCountByDataflowResponse](#schema-resultoflistofgetdatapacketscountbydataflowresponse) | Invalid window, for example a start date later than the end date |
| `401` | [ProblemDetails](#schema-problemdetails) | Unauthorized - user must have DataPackets.View permission |
| `500` | [ResultOfListOfGetDataPacketsCountByDataflowResponse](#schema-resultoflistofgetdatapacketscountbydataflowresponse) | Internal server error |

<a id="op-batchhistory-sendsummary"></a>
### POST `/api/v{version}/BatchHistory/send-summary`

operationId `BatchHistory_SendSummary` · Emails the batch history report for a window to the signed-in user

The recipient is resolved from the authenticated principal, not from the request, so this
endpoint can only mail the caller.

| Param | In | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | path | string | yes |  |

Request body `command` (application/json), **required**: [SendBatchHistorySummaryCommand](#schema-sendbatchhistorysummarycommand)

| Status | Body | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | [ResultOfString](#schema-resultofstring) | Report sent |
| `400` | [ResultOfString](#schema-resultofstring) | Invalid window, or the report could not be delivered |
| `401` | [ProblemDetails](#schema-problemdetails) | Unauthorized - user must have DataPackets.View permission |
| `500` | [ResultOfString](#schema-resultofstring) | Internal server error |

<a id="schema-getdatapacketscountbydataflowresponse"></a>
### GetDataPacketsCountByDataflowResponse

Message counts for a single dataflow over the requested window, broken down by status.
Mirrors the columns of the per-dataflow Batch History tab.

Required: `dataflowId`, `workspaceId`, `totalPackets`, `default`, `inQueue`, `success`, `resync`, `error`, `reQueued`, `refetch`, `archive`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dataflowId` | int64 | yes | Dataflow identifier. |
| `dataflowName` | string |  | Dataflow name. |
| `workspaceId` | int64 | yes | Identifier of the workspace the dataflow belongs to. |
| `workspaceName` | string |  | Name of the workspace the dataflow belongs to. |
| `totalPackets` | int32 | yes | Total messages in the window, across every status. |
| `default` | int32 | yes | Messages sitting in Default, the initial state before a message enters the queue. Normally zero — a non-zero count means messages were persisted but never picked up. |
| `inQueue` | int32 | yes | Messages still sitting in the queue. |
| `success` | int32 | yes | Messages processed successfully. |
| `resync` | int32 | yes | Messages selected for resync. |
| `error` | int32 | yes | Messages that failed. |
| `reQueued` | int32 | yes | Messages pushed back onto the queue for reprocessing. Retained on the contract for existing consumers, but no longer surfaced as a column on the Batch History page or in the summary email — it still contributes to TotalPackets. |
| `refetch` | int32 | yes | Messages selected to be refetched from source. |
| `archive` | int32 | yes | Messages archived rather than processed. |

<a id="schema-sendbatchhistorysummarycommand"></a>
### SendBatchHistorySummaryCommand

Emails the tenant-wide Batch History report for a window to the requesting user.

Required: `includeHidden`, `isChildIncluded`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fromDate` | string (date-time) |  | Start of the window (UTC). Defaults, like the query, to 24 hours before ToDate. |
| `toDate` | string (date-time) |  | End of the window (UTC). Defaults to now. |
| `includeHidden` | boolean | yes | Include dataflows hidden from the listings. |
| `isChildIncluded` | boolean | yes | Include child messages. False matches the page and the per-dataflow tab. |
